values: A credited finiteness deduction for restricted boundary-twist factorizations. Accepted scope: For every fixed g≥1, positive boundary-twist factorizations with pairwise curve intersection≤1 and no disk-bounding factors form finitely many simultaneous-conjugacy classes; M(g) is attained and finite, with 4g(2g+1)≤M(g). Repeats allowed. Limits: Arbitrary-length subquestion is answered negatively in fixed genus. Exact M(g) for g≥3, explicit upper formula and extremizer classification remain unresolved. This is possible eligibility for the literal boundedness subquestion, never a full resolution of the bundled maximum problem. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness remain unestablished. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; 4 fresh complete AI package reviews, latest zero actionable issues; no conventional human peer review or formal certification.
